Name: Spirit Wolf
Description: A ghostly wolf that intercepts enemies and deals melee damage. Fast and inexpensive.

Name: Phantom Archer
Description: A spectral ranged attacker that fires arrows at enemies from behind the front line.

Name: Soul Bomb
Description: A volatile spirit that moves into enemy groups and detonates, dealing massive AoE damage but sacrificing itself.

Name: Healing Wisp
Description: A passive aura pet that orbits the player and restores 3% max HP per second for the wisp's duration. Mutually exclusive with other wisps.

Name: Slowing Wisp
Description: A passive aura pet that slows all enemies within 6 tiles of the player by 30% while active. Mutually exclusive with other wisps.

Name: Curse Wisp
Description: A passive aura pet that applies 15 armor shred to all enemies within 6 tiles of the player (refreshed each frame) while active. Mutually exclusive with other wisps.
